units.source_text: 我流下了家父死时都没有流过的泪。

en.t: I shed tears that I had not shed even when my father died.

units.source_text: 因为比起父亲的死来，鹤川的死对我的关系更为重要。

en.t: For compared with my father's death, Tsurukawa's death mattered far more to me.

units.source_text: 自从认识柏木以后，我同鹤川的关系多少有点疏远了。

en.t: Since I had come to know Kashiwagi, my relationship with Tsurukawa had grown somewhat distant.

units.source_text: 如今失去了他，我更加值得，

en.t: Now that I had lost him, I realized all the more clearly,

units.source_text: 我同白昼的光明世界联系的一缕细丝，由于他的死而完全断掉了。

en.t: the single fine thread that connected me to the bright world of daylight had been completely severed by his death.

units.source_text: 我为失去的白昼，为失去的光明，为失去的夏天而哭泣了！

en.t: I wept for the lost daylight, for the lost brightness, for the lost summer!
